reserveReview.rationale: The issuer's September 30 balance table itemizes the complete JPY20,101,088,515 trust property: JPY10,303,388,515 ordinary deposits (51.26%), JPY8,800,000,000 term deposits (43.78%), and JPY997,700,000 Japanese government bonds at market value (4.96%). These disclosed percentages sum to 100; no inferred or normalized allocation is used. Outstanding trust-beneficiary issuance is separately reported as JPY20,070,668,515. This is current issuer self-verification, not an independent financial engagement or whole-chain supply reconciliation. Deposit-bank identities and allocations, term-deposit withdrawal conditions and maturities, and JGB positions and maturity limits are not disclosed. Legacy deposit risk is high because the underlying banks and terms are unnamed; JGB risk is medium because position duration is unestablished. The October 1 custody review retains its own clock.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Current trustee product disclosure and the June 30, 2026 governing terms were recovered on October 1. JPYSC trust property is separate from the trustee's bankruptcy estate; section 4(6) provides six months' notice for trustee resignation, successor appointment by the income beneficiary, court appointment if necessary, and transfer of trust assets and records to the successor. Section 13 requires segregation arrangements for qualifying delegated trust administration. Underlying deposit-bank identities, bank allocations, JGB custody venues and positions, and rehypothecation terms remain undisclosed. Bank failure and investment loss can impair redemption value under section 4(4). The statutory balance table remains dated June 30 and the September 7 release gives only a partial JGB figure, so no current full reserve split or provider shares are inferred.
